before.method: Reset counters after first frame; time Console._tick, Keyboard.poll and Show.frame with ticks_us. Only timer rearm caching changed in the A/B run.

after.method: Reset counters after first frame; time Console._tick, Keyboard.poll and Show.frame with ticks_us. Only timer rearm caching changed in the A/B run.

silence_detection: 10 ms windows; reference RMS > 0.02 FS and captured RMS < 0.001 FS. Relative-level differences remain in low-level passages; this is not proof of identical capture frequency response.
obs_routing: Dedicated audio input -6 dB, duplicate microphone and desktop inputs muted.
fixes: Cache timer class and time module outside periodic callbacks.
Propagate callback KeyboardInterrupt to foreground VM.
Recover ownership from native generation/state across interrupted acquisition and snapshot.
Reset core1 after worker completion before GC can reuse its stack; clock changes otherwise trigger idle FIFO IRQ on the freed stack.
Pin immutable score owners before extracting C buffer pointers.
Increase end-card margin; exclude CPython bytecode from app archive.
scope: One RP2040 board, finite tests. No physical keyboard connected. OBS recording and seven scene checkpoints were checked; no claim of perceptual listening.
